title: Some St. Cloud area Locations From SCSU To Abandoned Storefronts Have Paranormal Histories
excerpt: Areas around St. Cloud and Central Minnesota and the paranormal activity that has been reported
content:
First of all - yes, there are ghosts and spirits around.  I have come to grips with that reality.  However, I do not, under any circumstances want to see "dead people" like the 6th Sense.

If you are looking for something to do around the area for the upcoming Halloween weekend, these places might be some things you would want to check out.

PLACES OUTSIDE OF ST CLOUD THAT HAVE PARANORMAL ACTIVITY

Palmer House Hotel in Sauk Centre.  This hotel is under new ownership, and has been known to have active ghosts and spirits.  They will also, on occasion have themed events showing off their paranormal activity.

The Thayer Hotel in Annandale. There have been reports of paranormal activity in this hotel.  It most famously had Al Capone as a guest when it was a railroad station stop.  Capone allegedly stayed on the top floor.  Most of the paranormal activity has been reported on the 2nd and 3rd floors where the guest rooms are located.  Great.

REPORTEDLY HAUNTED PLACES IN AND AROUND ST. CLOUD

There are a few places around St. Cloud that infamously have haunted claims.

Pioneer Place, downtown St. Cloud on 5th Avenue.  This is such a cool venue, with a speakeasy located in the basement.  With that said, it's only fitting that this place would be the home to some paranormal activity.  I have been in this building several times and have never seen or felt any sort of a presence.  However, people who work there tell a different story.  It's a great place to enjoy some awesome music, get a dynamite drink, or venture to the Speakeasy where they have some craft cocktails and small plates shareable foods.

THE FORMER DB SEARLES ON 5TH AVENUE IN ST. CLOUD

The building right next to the Pioneer Place is also supposedly haunted.  I have heard this for years.  It was DB Searle's then Searle's on 5th, and most recently, Tequila Town.  Now, as far as I know, it sits empty.  Just letting the spirits live there without being bothered.  And this place, like the Pioneer Place, has reportedly had some sightings.  I have never seen anything.  But, again, people who have worked there tell a different story.

SCSU CAMPUS SUPPOSEDLY HAS SOME HAUNTED BUILDINGS

St. Cloud State Campus.  I guess there has been some reports of paranormal activity here too.  Mostly un certain buildings.  One is a dormatory - Shoemaker Hall.  That is the building closet to University Drive, by the walking bridge.  The other two buildings are equally as old.  Riverview, which has been totally renovated.  So, maybe the spirits moved on?  And then there was Lawrence Hall.  I don't believe that building is used very much, if ever, anymore.

So, St. Cloud State campus may or may not have any paranormal activity.  I'm guessing that if there was some at one time, it's fairly likely that there still is.  Just make friends with the ghosts.  Again, I do NOT want to see dead people!  But if you do, might be kind of fun to do on Halloween evening.
